verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents dashboards that monitor cost across models, tags, or users, a Metrics API for aggregate cost and usage, and session and user tracking. Together these support attributing cost to users and to tag-based features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of attaching arbitrary custom metadata for cost attribution, explicit per-session cost breakdowns, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cost attribution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata

citations.quote: Create dashboards: monitor cost across models, tags, or users.
Support for tracking multi-turn conversations as sessions and user tracking
Query aggregate cost, usage, latency, volume, or score metrics
Analyze cost, latency, volume, and quality in custom dashboards
